query: WITH updated AS (UPDATE tasks SET status = $2 WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id) INSERT INTO task_events (id, recorded_at, sequence, event_type, event) SELECT updated.id, COALESCE($3, NOW()), ROW_NUMBER() OVER () + $4, unnested.event_type, unnested.event FROM updated CROSS JOIN UNNEST($5::TEXT[], $6::JSONB[]) AS unnested(event_type, event) RETURNING recorded_at
